title: Aegis
tagline: AI Automated Yield Hunter! Easy, Professional, Secure, Personalized. Understands you, serves you.
description:
Aegis is an automated yield protocol (AutoFi) that identifies optimal DeFi opportunities and manages user positions autonomously.

Aegis is also an AI-powered platform where users interact through chat. The system generates contextual UI elements and charts in real-time.

Unlike other AI Agent projects, Aegis doesn't construct blockchain transactions for users or answer general knowledge questions. We believe these complicate things and increase the learning curve. Aegis focuses solely on automated yield—simple and specialized.

Simple enough for anyone. Specialized enough to trust.

Great products speak for themselves. Try it now.
how_its_made:
Aegis has two core components: chat bots for user interaction and auto-fi bots for investment management.

Chat bots are LangGraph-orchestrated agents handling user accounts, investment strategies, asset queries, on-chain data, knowledge base, workflows, UI generation, and evaluation—powered by LLMs. The system integrates Blockscout's MCP service to interpret on-chain transactions and ERC-4337 UserOps.

Auto-fi bots are LangGraph-orchestrated agents managing risk assessment, investment recommendations, and transaction construction—also LLM-powered. They connect to Aave, Morpho, Pendle, Extrafi, and other DeFi protocols.

Aegis uses Base's ERC-4337 account model. Users and agents co-manage a Smart Contract Account holding all positions and funds, making every transaction transparent on-chain.

For better UX, Aegis use solutions from Blockscout's MCPs, Envio's indexing service, ASI's models and the Agentverse.
